content: Yesumi Yuu Kyau Dokona PiiMana Lamaiya
Wambu ama malu rukuraka pyuo kareyaminyi kandapala baa yuu kyau dokona pulyuo peya. Pulyuo pao pisapeyamo dokopa banya disaepole dupwa baa peteya dokona epeyami.
Dokopa baame kambu roma lumbwapala dopa lao mana lamaiya.
Rae Maingi Renge Angi

content.text: Wambu range kuki lao suu pyapala inyimungu karaminyi dupwa
yake pandana isingi yulu doko nakamana ingyuo silyamo dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
mona minyarambu poraiyakamira dokona rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
yuu muu dupwa nakamana sera dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
Wambu yulu rolae pimwali yaka lao nanome kumuo karenge dupwa
sikya pira ingilyamo dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
Wambu yango sakame kumuo karenge wambu dupwa kando
Anatumi kondoko karara dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
Wambu mona mendaki palyuo karaminyi dupwame
Anatu kandarami dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
Pau lanyi pyambuo minyuo nyepa pingi wambu dupwa
Anatunya wane ingyuo karaminyi larami dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.
Wambu lapo rolaena renge dokona lao randa nyerami dupwa
yake pandana isingi yulu doko nakamana silyamo dokona nakama rae maiyuo pelyaminyi.

content: Nakama nambana wambu ingyuo kararaminyisa akali lapome nakama kilya kandalya kandana pyuo lao lekeleke ralamisi lao nakama yulu koo wakale wakale malu pingiŋi lao kyambo leyami kande dokopa nakama keta renge keyange paliramo kararami.

Dokopa yake panda dokona renge kulisa andake nyerami lyakande. Dokona mona anda pyakalyuo pyao raeko maiyuo karalapape. Dokonako palyuo Anatumi banya poropeta akali wambo kareyami dupwa akali dupwame dopako pyuo lekeleke rena lapa pyuo kareyami.
Kurisene Wambu Dupwa Kotape Isare Lambepe Dopale Ingyuo Karaminyi

Nakama isa yuu dakena kota dopale ingyuo karaminyi. Karaminyipape kota kemara ramo doko apa pyuo keke pinya larami. Kemasi dokome angi mende kapa pii narama. Mee nembaramanopa akali dupwame kimbu yukuna dokome kalyarami ingilyamo.
Nakama isa wambu dupwana kukwa kendapulinyi mendeke ingyuo karaminyi. Yuu kyau dokona taone andake mende pirami ramo doko yalu pii nange.
Doko suu pyao wambu lambe kaipala penge mendena pee pii napala rate singi dokona retenge. Dokopa anda dongepe dupwa peparaena rao yanga paupau lenge.

Doko suu pyao nakama kukwana kendapulinya mendeke ingyuo wambu dupwana lenge kambu dokona karo yanga paupau lao karalapape. Dokopa nakamana yulu keyange pyuo kararami dupwa kandapala Rakange yake panda karamo doko ketae pyambwamili lao pyuo kararami.
Mawa Pii Dokona Lao Mana Lamaiya

Mawa Pii dokope Anatunya poropeta lao kareyami akali dupwana pii dokope nambame isa pena lala epeeŋe lao suu pyaa nalapape. Isa pena lala epeyonde daa. Mawa pii leyami dupwa peparae namba keta angi ingyuo para.

Dokona lao kinyi langilyu, yake pandape isa yuupi pyakuiyuo isa paa nao mee seramopa pii palamuli pyuo peparae dokona mawa pii kuki mendepe pepa litinya silyamo dokona mendepe yuu gii ene pyaka sepa naramopa isa paa nara lao daa leto.

Dokona wamba mendeme mee Mawa Pii kuki dokona mende yalo papala wambu yango dupwa dopako pipwape lao mana lamairami ramo doko yake pandana isingi yulu dokona karaminyi dupwana kamame isa pele lao karaminyiŋi larami. Dopa laraminyipa wambu mendeme pii palamo dokonako palyuo pyuo dopa pimana pipwape lao mana lao kararami ramo doko yake pandana isingi yulu palamo sukusa karaminyi dupwana mupwa ingyuo karaminyiŋi larami.

Dokona lao dopa langilyu. Mawa Pii mana lenge akalipi Parisi akalipi dupwana yulu kapa ingya nayasa nakamana yulu rolae dokome dolomana yulu doko nyuo enaka nara ramo doko yake pandana isingi yulu dokona sukusa paa narami leya.
Mona Koo Palenge Dokona ManaPii Lapo
Wambu yango pyaa nalapape lao mawa pii doko yuu wamba paleyamo siyami. Mendeme mendali pyara ramo doko kote larami ingilyamo, lenge doko nakama singi.

Dopa leyako doŋo nambame nakama dopa langilyu. Mendeme yangonge mende kando imbwuara ramo doko baa keta kote sera ingilyamo. Mendeme yangonge mende kilya kandalya kandana pyuo lara ramo doko kote andake doko baa keta palira ingilyamo. Mendeme yangonge mende kando, Emba kopyali lao koo keta palyuo lao nembara ramo doko baa isare panda para ingyuowale karara.
Dokona suu pyao Anatu suu pyao mena kiso maingi rate dokona bange mende maiyala eparaminyipa yangonge mendeme namba kando ingi koo palyuo karapya kandapi lao range suu piyami kande doko.
Bange reto maingi dokona mairamili bange doko mee retapala kandakala pao wambo yangonge doko ingi keyange palyinyi pyambwapala enakana bange doko Anatu suu pyao maiyalapape.

Dopako pyuo dee embapa kote laramo akali angi dokopa ene karara kote lala pao karo dokopa baapa waiya lao mona mendaki palyuo pako lapala kuma soo kandape. Dopa pipa nare ramo dokopa emba nyuo jasi keta mairasa dokome yanda singi mairamopa emba puu anda palyasasara.
Kinyi langilyu, kana kuki lasaka pirinyi dokopa mokwa nara. Kumasi kana maiyuo lyolo pirinyi gii dokopa emba moko nembara.
Kepo Pingi Yulu Dokona LaoMana Lamaiya
Kepo pyakami nalapape, lao kareyami doko nakama singi kandale.
Dopa leyako doŋo nambame mende langiru. Mendeme kepo pipuli lao suu pyara ramo doko banya suu pingi dokome enda dokopa kepo pyuo kaeyarasa pira.

Embena lenge rolae dokome emba suu longwanyi koo keta pyambuya kande doko lukunyi nembape. Embena yongo dokona kuki pingyu isa para ramo doko kapa. Dokona doŋo embena yanenge peparae isare panda nembarami doko ama kapa daa.

Dopako pyuo embena kingi rolae dokome emba suu longwanyi koo keta pyambuya kande doko pyao pyakepanyi nembape. Embena yanenge dokona mende isa para ramo doko kapa kuki. Dokoko doŋo yongo peparae isare panda para ramo doko ama kapa daa.
Enda Ramanyi Nembenge Dokona Lao Mana Lamaiya
Dee pii mende lao, Akali mendeme banya enda ramanyi nembara ramo doko pepa pase mende ramanyi nembelyo lao pyapala maira, lenge kandapi.

Dopa leyako doŋo nambame pil mende langiru doko, Akali mendeme banya etenge dokome akali wakale mende kepo pii naramopa ramanyi nembara ramo doko enda doko kepo pyuo petena lao nembarasa pira. Akali mendeme enda ramanyi nembasi doko nyera ramo doko kepo pili laoko nyerasa pira.
Kinyi Lalu Lao Lenge Pii Dokona Lao Mana Lamaiya
Yuu wamba dokopa mendeme Anatu kando karamo lapala mende piro lao kingi ketae nembara ramo dokopa enakana kaeyaramo doko koo leyami kande.
Dopa pyuo leyami doŋo nakama mende pinya lao lalu lao larami ramo dokopa, kingi ketae nemba nawape yake panda doko Anatunya petenge isa dokona kingi laa nawape
isa yuu doko banya kimbu isa dokona kingi laa nawape dee Jerusaleme taone doko Kiŋi Andakena ingilyamo dokona kingi lao kingi ketae nembo laa nalapape leto.
Dee kyawasi minyuo pii kinyi leto lao laa nalapapeko. Dokona lao kyawa yaku doko pupu ranyi reto dee pupuri doko yaku epanyi sero piraminde daa.

Kinyi larama lao suu pyarami ramo doko mee, Waa, lalapape. Dee, Daa, larama lao suu pyarami ramo doko mee, Daa, lalapape. Pii mende dokona konda pyuo larami ramo doko kopetame suu pyapala laramisa pira.
Wambu Isingi Pyarami Dokona ManaPii Lapo

Wamba pii mende lao dokopa mendeme wambu yangonya lenge pyao ranjarami ramo dokopa banya lenge dokoko isingi pyao ranjarami. Nenge dokona mende pyao longwarami ramo dokopa banya nenge dokona mendeko isingi pyao longwarami, leyaminyi nakama singi kandale.

Dopa leyaminyiko doŋo nambame pii mende langilyu. Wambu koo mendeme emba randa jiya kande dokopa baa isingi pyaa nalapape. Wakena paki pyapeya kande dokopa baame dee pakirena pinya lao kapu kyelapape.
Mende doko, wambu mendeme kote lapala embena komau isa pee pingi doko nyiya kande dokopa dee komau ketae pee pingi doko opetae maipwape.
Dee, wambu mendeme emba puu maiyuo nanesale mendasa ipu leya kande dokopa dee kata dopale lama kamameko konda pyuo pupwape.
Bange mende mee julu joo jipili yaka leyami kande dokopa mee maipwape. Dee, range peyakaro lao jii leyami kande dokopa daa laa nalapape.
Nyisu Petenge Wambu Dupwa Mona Retalapape
Nakama pipya parali maki pyuo palenge wambu dupwa mona reto nyisu petenge wambu dupwa awa nao pyuo karalapape, leyaminyi nakama singi kandale.
Dopa leyaminyiko doŋo nambame nakama pii mende langiru. Nakama pipya nyisu petenge wambu dupwa mona reto, randa nalamisi lao piyami dupwa ateŋa lakamyuo pyuo karalapape.

Dopa pyuo pirami ramo dokopa nakamana Rakane yake panda karenge dokona wane wanakepe ingyuo parami. Dokona lao baame banya neta doko wambu koo keyangepe peparaena lao pyakalyapala rena lenge. Dopako pyuo apunda doko wambu rolae pingi rolae pii nangepe peparaena lao epena lenge.
Nakama mona retarami wambu dusipa yeelyo isingi mona retaraminde ramo doko keyange keta parama lao suu pyaa nalapape. Takisi nyingi akali dupwame dopako pii nangese?
Dee yangone dupwa iki yako lao kararami ramo doko mee wambu dopako pyuo karaminyi dokona nakamame aki yulu wakasa mende piramisa pirase? Juu daa rara wakale wambu dupwa opetae dopako pii nangese?
Dokona nakamana Rakane yake panda karenge doko ama rolae wakasa pyuo karamo doko suu pyao nakama ama rolae wakasako pyuo karalapape.
